item.title: Fools Gold Pt. I
item.description:
I think chris here is trying to say that moving on or letting go becomes easy only when you’ve seen all that that relationship can become, or you achieve some kind of closure.

“Holding onto a thread” is he talking about holding onto a small memory? Is that why it’s difficult for him to move on?

“A kiss is better when you give it back”, yep I think he’s clarifying that reciprocated love is the only love that’s worth something. Might be wrong but I don’t agree with the statement, of course.

item.title: ONE
item.description:
Is he talking about his mental health here?

“Takes a village, Takes a home”, “On a night like this, there’s no one man show”

Maybe he wants to show that being alone or tackling mental issues alone will not work, as you need support and encouragement and reassurance and more ?

“You give me something to believe in” “Carve my name onto my naked chest”, how love could help handle problems and provide a safe space? To show that the new or “fixed” me bears your name?
